basis: Scottish wind = every transmission-connected wind unit in Elexon's register whose grid zone is North Scotland (_P) or South Scotland (_N); the zone comes from gspGroupId where Elexon fills it and otherwise from the unit's transmission loss factor, which Elexon sets per zone. Output = Elexon B1610 settlement meter data, latest settlement run. Capacity = registered capacity of the units that generated in the month. Planned output = Final Physical Notification (FPN). What the wind allowed = the larger of metered and planned output, so a farm paid to switch off is not counted as becalmed. A calm is a run of half-hours in which what the wind allowed stayed below 10% of capacity. Firm = metered Torness + Peterhead. Small distribution-connected wind is not metered by Elexon and is not included.
source: Elexon B1610 (settlement meter data) + PN (physical notifications) + BM unit register
